summary.text: Thirty-Eight Sealing Arts is a killer move Giant Sun's will names during the fight around Wisdom Gu. It seals Gu worms and is stronger than pitch black Gu.

claims.text: Giant Sun’s will drops a large group of mortal Gu above Hei Lou Lan’s group and splits itself so the Gu enter everyone’s apertures. Every person receives thirty-eight Gu, already refined by the will, and learns the killer move through those directions. Giant Sun’s will calls it a small trick his main body created without a name, then names it Thirty-Eight Sealing Arts. Hei Lou Lan’s group activates it and breathes rays of purple light qi from their mouths.

The move is targeted against Gu worms. It can contaminate moves a Gu Master uses, and the Gu worms used for those moves are sealed one after another. It cannot seal Immortal Gu. For mortal Gu, the higher the rank, the shorter the duration of the seal. It can seal them completely. The Gu worms that form the move are mostly ordinary and can be easily gathered. It touches upon qi path, and even if an attacking Gu is used, it can follow the qi back to the source and seal that Gu. Historically, sealing defensive Gu was easy while sealing attacking Gu was difficult, but thirty-eight sealing arts can deal with both equally. After Fang Yuan is struck, stone barrier shield Gu, flying bone shield Gu, and wind blade Gu are sealed in turn.

Fang Yuan turns into a six arm heavenly zombie king completely and stops the activation of all his Gu. As the purple light qi hits him, thirty-eight sealing arts has no effect. As long as he does not activate his Gu worms, the purple light qi cannot follow the qi within and trace it back to the source.

Known users.text: Giant Sun Immortal Venerable (creator) Hei Lou Lan Ye Lui Sang
